slides.texte_overlay:
small swaps that will quietly
fix your attention span

podcasts for silence

swap one podcast a day for a walk in silence. your brain needs empty space to process what it already took in, and silence is where your best thoughts show up.

reels for one long video

swap ten short videos for one long documentary. following a single idea for an hour rebuilds the deep attention that endless short clips slowly wore away.

scrolling for one lesson

swap 5 minutes of scrolling for one short lesson: a planet, a painting, a moment in history. finishing something small trains the attention that quick hits destroy.
slides.texte_sophia:
scrolling for one lesson

i swapped 5 minutes of scrolling for one short lesson a day. i do it with the Sophia app, one lesson a day, and finishing something small rebuilt my attention span.

slides.texte_overlay:
notifications for batches

swap constant notifications for checking messages three times a day. every ping breaks your focus for far longer than the few seconds it takes to look.

background tv for music

swap the tv you leave on for quiet instrumental music. background noise with words keeps part of your brain busy listening, even when you think you're not.
